Definition: a session, i.e. company of persons (in close deliberation); by implication, intimacy, consultation, a secret
BiblicalUsage: 1) council, counsel, assembly; 1a) council (of familiar conversation); 1a1) divan, circle (of familiar friends); 1a2) assembly, company; 1b) counsel; 1b1) counsel (itself); 1b2) secret counsel; 1b3) familiar converse, intimacy (with God)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
